serverInfo.name: Derrick
serverInfo.description: B2B data enrichment for Google Sheets - find emails, phones, LinkedIn data, company info, SIRET/SIREN, tech stacks, and more. 100+ data points per lead.

authentication.description: Install the MCP without an API key - the server prompts for one on the first tool call. The API key lives in the Derrick Google Sheets add-on (Settings → API access) and requires the Standard plan (€20/mo) or above for API/MCP access.

derrick_find_email.description: Find the best professional email for a person from a LinkedIn URL, or from first name + last name + company. Returns the email + confidence score.

derrick_find_phone.description: Find mobile or office phone number from a LinkedIn URL or contact name.

derrick_enrich_profile.description: Returns 30+ data points about a LinkedIn profile : job title, seniority, location, tenure, past roles, education, skills.

derrick_enrich_companies.description: Returns company data from a name, domain, or LinkedIn URL : headcount, industry, funding, HQ, social profiles, founded year.

derrick_data_gouv.description: French legal entity data from data.gouv.fr : SIRET, SIREN, NAF code, registered address, share capital, last filing date.

derrick_find_tech.description: Detect technologies a company uses on its website : CRM, analytics, hosting, frameworks, payment, ATS, marketing tools.

derrick_verify_email.description: Real-time SMTP verification : returns valid, risky, catch-all, role-based, or disposable.

derrick_search_linkedin_profile.description: Query LinkedIn for profiles matching job title + company + location. Returns ranked profile URLs + names.

derrick_search_companies.description: Find companies matching industry, size, geography, and tech stack filters. Returns up to 100 companies.

derrick_search_leads_in_companies.description: Within a target company, return leads matching a job-title pattern (e.g. all Heads of Growth).

derrick_website_contact_social.description: Scrape a company website for emails, phones, and social profiles in the footer / contact page.

derrick_serp_first_result.description: Google's #1 result for any query. Useful for verifying a company's official URL, news, or fact-checking.

pricing.cost_model: Credit cost varies by endpoint - see each tool's credit_cost field. Typical examples : find_email = 5 credits, find_phone = 150 credits, enrich_profile = 1 credit, verify_email = 1 credit, search_companies = 1 credit per result.
pricing.notes: Unused credits roll over on all paid plans. API/MCP access is unlocked starting on the Standard plan (€20/mo) - Free and Mini tiers do not expose API keys.

rate_limits.backoff: Exponential with jitter on 429. Recommended initial delay : 2 s, max delay : 60 s.

installation.note: The MCP installs without an API key - the server requests one at first tool call. To skip that prompt, set DERRICK_API_KEY in your client's env or via --env on install.

claude-code.command: claude mcp add derrick -- npx -y derrick-mcp
claude-code.command_with_key: claude mcp add derrick --env DERRICK_API_KEY=$YOUR_KEY -- npx -y derrick-mcp

claude-web.ui_path: Settings → Customize → Connectors → Add MCP server
claude-web.auth: The server prompts for the API key on first call ; or set Authorization: Bearer <your-key> in the connector config.

featured_examples.title: Build a target-account list
featured_examples.prompt: Find 50 Series-A SaaS companies in France with 50-200 employees that use HubSpot. For each, return name, domain, HQ city, and the LinkedIn URL of the Head of Sales.

featured_examples.title: Enrich a CSV of leads
featured_examples.prompt: I'll paste 30 LinkedIn URLs. Return each person's email, phone, current company, job title.

featured_examples.title: Verify a batch of emails
featured_examples.prompt: Verify these 100 emails. Group by status. For risky ones, explain why.

featured_examples.title: Track tech stack changes
featured_examples.prompt: List tech used by competitor.com today and diff vs my notes from 3 months ago.
